synopsis: “This academy has multiple ‘taboos’—” Seirin Girls' Academy — a prestigious institution steeped in history, renowned as one of the prefecture's foremost finishing schools for young ladies. The most terrifying school mystery, filled with unsettling unease and psychological terror! (Source; Young Champion Web, translated)
